name: Towerborne: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Step into the world of Towerborne with the Deluxe Edition, a premium bundle built to jumpstart your journey and keep you looking sharp as you face the wilds beyond the Belfry. Outfit your Ace with the Numbers Cosmetic Set and the Lazurite Cosmetic Set, then further customize your progression with 6 additional Rare Aspects and major drops of crafting resources—a supply of Core crafting materials plus a trove of Advanced crafting materials. The Deluxe Edition helps you unlock customizations faster and style your adventure your way. Ideal for players who want early flexibility in builds and a distinctive look from day one.

Forge, fight, and flourish—alone or alongside your crew—on your path to become a legendary Ace of Towerborne.
What’s included:
• Numbers Cosmetic Set
• Lazurite Cosmetic Set
• 6 additional Rare Aspects
• Supply of Core crafting materials
